scenes.title: Before you submit your statement of purpose…
scenes.say: Before you submit your statement of purpose, run four quick checks.

scenes.title: Did you answer their prompt?
scenes.body: Each programme asks something slightly different.
scenes.say: One: did you answer this programme's prompt? Each one asks something slightly different.

scenes.title: Name the right school
scenes.body: Copy-paste errors are common and costly.
scenes.say: Two: is the right university named everywhere? Copy and paste errors are common.

scenes.title: Can you back up every claim?
scenes.body: Keep to what your transcript, CV and referees support.
scenes.say: Three: can you back up every claim with your transcript, C V or referees?

scenes.title: Within the word limit
scenes.body: Portals often cut off or reject long text.
scenes.say: Four: are you within the word limit? Portals often cut off long text.
